description: Kept the songs as the end of the play.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Named Shrove Tuesday the fourth of March, and the stop.
name: George Bryan

description: Stood at the table while the marks went in. His face is not on the page.
name: John Heminges

description: Active in Fixed the twentieth and the Shrove Tuesday stop
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Asked three full weeks for Berowne, and took the twentieth.
name: Richard Burbage

name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for the jig, and stood under the refusal.
name: Will Kemp
